schema.text: Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do you use most often?
schema.help: A cargo bike has a large box or platform for carrying children or goods. Shared bikes with a station are picked up and returned at fixed points; those without a station can be left anywhere within the service area.

en.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do you use most often?
en.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: A cargo bike has a large box or platform for carrying children or goods. Shared bikes with a station are picked up and returned at fixed points; those without a station can be left anywhere within the service area.

it.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Bicicletta condivisa / a noleggio (con o senza stazione)
it.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: Quale tipo di bicicletta o di monopattino usi più spesso?
it.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: La cargo bike ha un grande cassone o pianale per trasportare bambini o merci. Le bici condivise con stazione si prendono e si restituiscono in punti fissi; quelle senza stazione si possono lasciare ovunque nell'area del servizio.
it.#Shared / hire e-scooter: Monopattino elettrico in sharing / a noleggio

fr.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Vélo partagé / de location (avec ou sans station)
fr.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: Quel type de vélo ou de trottinette électrique utilisez-vous le plus souvent ?
fr.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: Un vélo cargo possède un grand bac ou un plateau pour transporter des enfants ou des marchandises. Les vélos partagés avec station se prennent et se rendent à des points fixes ; ceux sans station peuvent être laissés n'importe où dans la zone du service.
fr.#Shared / hire e-scooter: Trottinette électrique en libre-service / de location

de.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Leih- oder Sharing-Fahrrad (mit oder ohne Station)
de.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: Welche Art von Fahrrad oder E-Scooter nutzen Sie am häufigsten?
de.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: Ein Lastenrad hat eine große Box oder Ladefläche, um Kinder oder Waren zu transportieren. Sharing-Fahrräder mit Station werden an festen Punkten ausgeliehen und zurückgegeben; solche ohne Station können überall im Servicegebiet abgestellt werden.

tr.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: En sık hangi tür bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter kullanıyorsunuz?
tr.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: Kargo bisikletinde çocuk ya da yük taşımak için büyük bir kasa veya platform bulunur. İstasyonlu paylaşımlı bisikletler sabit noktalardan alınıp oraya bırakılır; istasyonsuz olanlar hizmet alanı içinde herhangi bir yere bırakılabilir.

fa.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: دوچرخه اشتراکی / کرایه‌ای (با ایستگاه یا بدون ایستگاه)
fa.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: بیشتر از چه نوع دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: دوچرخهٔ باری یک جعبه یا سکوی بزرگ برای حمل کودکان یا بار دارد. دوچرخه‌های اشتراکی با ایستگاه از نقاط ثابت برداشته و به همان‌جا بازگردانده می‌شوند؛ دوچرخه‌های بدون ایستگاه را می‌توان هر جایی در محدودهٔ خدمات گذاشت.

hu.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: Közösségi / bérelt kerékpár (dokkolós vagy dokkoló nélküli)
hu.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: Milyen típusú kerékpárt vagy elektromos rollert használ a leggyakrabban?
hu.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: A teherkerékpárnak nagy doboza vagy platója van gyerekek vagy áruk szállítására. A dokkolós közösségi kerékpárokat fix pontokon lehet felvenni és leadni; a dokkoló nélkülieket a szolgáltatási területen belül bárhol le lehet tenni.

ar.#Shared / hire bicycle (docked or dockle: دراجة مشتركة / للإيجار (بمحطة أو من دون محطة)
ar.#Which type of bicycle or e-scooter do y: ما نوع الدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي الذي تستخدمه في أغلب الأحيان؟
ar.#A cargo bike has a large box or platfor: دراجة الشحن مزوّدة بصندوق أو منصة كبيرة لنقل الأطفال أو البضائع. الدراجات المشتركة بمحطة تؤخذ وتُعاد في نقاط ثابتة، أما التي من دون محطة فيمكن تركها في أي مكان داخل منطقة الخدمة.
